summary: Root-cause diagnosis: rowToDefinition performs 4 sequential fallible dupe() calls (name, version, description, stage) plus 1 fallible parseGraphJson() call, with no errdefer guards. Any mid-sequence allocation failure leaks the dupes that already succeeded. Classified as Category A (logic error) — source is wrong, no test change. The fix pattern is already established in the same file at lines 1318-1421 (parseGraphJson, fixed in WF03-ISS-0132-20260807 as PGJ-1/PGJ-2/PGJ-3). Refactor: extract a fixture-driven rowToDefinitionFromFields(allocator, fields, fallback) signature so std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures can drive it. Then add a tests/unit/ allocation-failure test that fails on the unfixed function and passes after the fix.
